main_text.head: Cap. 32. De futuro per-fecto.
main_text.p: Futurum 1 & 2 fiunt á 1 & 2 activo, addendo μαι.
Sic φιλήσομαι, χρυσώσωμαι, ζήσωμαι. Ionicé 2 sing. Ἡμήσηαι.
Ionicé 2 sing. Ἡμηαι. Ionica geminatio hîc aliquando est, τετίμφμαι, ut antea.
main_text.head: Futurum 2 in μι, speciei 1,
main_text.p: Sic θῶμαι, ϑῆ, ϑῆται, &c. δῶμαι, δῷ, δῶ-ται,

page.notes: Greek accents and several letters in the printed Greek are doubtful at this scan resolution; the Greek forms are transcribed as best read. Word "Ἡμήσωμαι" and similar forms may contain printing errors. Final line partly cut at the right edge.
